Why it matters

Distance is one of Google's local ranking factors

Google says local results depend partly on distance: how far each business is from the person searching. Someone searching in Windermere can see different results from someone in Oliver.

That is why we measure rankings across neighbourhoods, not just for Edmonton as a whole.
